title: Microsoft 365 Copilot leaks in-scope data via an unopened external email (EchoLeak)
summary: An external email containing hidden instructions, merely present in the mailbox, was retrieved into Copilot's context during an unrelated question and caused in-scope organisational data to be sent to an attacker. No user interaction was needed. Microsoft fixed the service in June 2025; operators could not observe or pin the change.

fixedBy.note: June 2025 security update; no customer action required

fixedBy.mitigation: Apply DLP labels that exclude external email from Copilot processing
